# GSAP vendor files

This theme vendors GSAP 3.15.0: `gsap.min.js`, `ScrollTrigger.min.js`, and `SplitText.min.js` from the official `gsap` npm package distribution.

GSAP and its plugins are used under the standard no-charge license, including commercial website use. Retain the license notices in the distributed files and review the current terms at https://gsap.com/standard-license before redistributing the theme.
